mentions.name: mensara
mentions.description: This app provides multiplayer memory so a whole team can work together with AI coding software. It lets users work with various AI agents, such as muse, grokbot, and dots, all of which know the user immediately and can collaborate with each other.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building mensara, multi player memory so you're whole team can work together with ai coding software.

One of the most fun things is you can use all the various agents, like muse, grokbot, dots etc and they all know you immediately and can work together.
